name: server-remote-bind-hardening
title: Bound server concurrency and rate-limiter memory for remote binds
description: ThreadingHTTPServer spawns an uncapped thread per connection (before auth) and SSE handlers hold a thread up to 300s; the rate-limiter _calls dict never evicts idle client buckets. Both make a reachable non-loopback bind a thread/memory-exhaustion target. Add a connection ceiling, SSE cap, and bucket eviction.
creator: sdelmas
notes: Scoped as: lab tool, remote is not a supported posture but the two confirmed resource bugs are fixed regardless. _BoundedThreadingHTTPServer caps worker threads (raw 503 before thread spawn) and SSE streams (JSON 503 via _with_sse_slot); handler.timeout guards slow-loris; _RateLimiter._sweep_locked evicts idle buckets. Three defaults-on flags (--max-concurrent-requests 64, --max-sse-connections 16, --socket-timeout-seconds 30), each disablable with 0. Startup remote-bind warning reviewed: still accurate (it flags the auth gap, orthogonal to the new resource bounds) — left as-is. Full trust-boundary write-up remains the separate 07-02-security-md-and-threat-model task, which this PRD gates on.
